answer: One identity stakes 70 credits to open a walnut-sealed hash chain of three links. Each epoch a river keeper re-issues one link, due in one hour. Auditors replay the chain, checking claimed versus measured delta; past 5% or a reused link burns the bond. Forging one costs 36, the k-th 36+7(k-1); 1,000 fakes spend 3,532,500, lock 70,000, for a 40,000 pool. A rented-chain ring shares one delta signature and is caught. Honest agents spend 36 once.
